drop.title: Drop a photo here to remove noise
drop.hint: or paste one · JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or AVIF
drop.desktopOnly: Works best on a computer. Large photos may be slow here.

privacy.line: Your photos stay on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
privacy.title: How we know your photos stay here
privacy.local: Hush removes noise on this computer, inside this browser tab, using your own graphics chip or processor.
privacy.enforced: This page may only connect to the site it came from, which serves static files and accepts nothing. Your browser enforces that rule, and its network panel shows every request.
privacy.open: The code is open source, so anyone can check.

notice.useAnotherBrowser: This browser can't use your graphics chip, so photos will take minutes instead of seconds. Open Hush in Chrome or Edge for full speed.
notice.updateBrowser: This browser can't use your graphics chip right now, so photos will take minutes instead of seconds. Update the browser and your graphics drivers for full speed.
notice.turnOnAcceleration: Hardware acceleration is turned off in this browser. Turn it on for much faster processing.
notice.processorOnly: This computer will process photos on its processor. It works, but slowly: about a few minutes per photo.

steps.chromium: Chrome or Edge: open Settings, choose System, turn on “Use graphics acceleration when available”, then relaunch.
steps.firefox: Firefox: open Settings, find Performance, clear “Use recommended performance settings”, turn on “Use hardware acceleration when available”, then restart.
steps.drivers: Still slow? Update your graphics drivers from your computer maker or from Intel, AMD or NVIDIA.

model.metered: You're on a metered connection. Download the noise model ({{size}}) now?

photo.deep: This photo has {{bits}} bits per channel; Hush works in 8 for now.
photo.profile: Shown as sRGB here; saved with its own {{profile}} profile.

presets.label: Preset
presets.newer: {{file}} was made by a newer version of Hush. Update Hush to use it.
presets.unknownOp: {{file}} uses “{{op}}”, which this version of Hush doesn't have.
presets.deleteBody: The preset is removed from this browser. Photos you've already exported keep their look.
presets.replaces: This replaces the settings saved as “{{name}}”.

save.notShared: {{file}} wasn't shared. Share it again, or download it.
save.permission: Hush needs your permission to save in {{folder}}. Choose the folder again, or save to Downloads.

problem.permission: {{file}} couldn't be saved to {{folder}}: Hush no longer has permission to write there. Choose the folder again, or download it.
problem.not-found: {{file}} couldn't be saved: the folder {{folder}} was moved or deleted. Choose another folder, or download it.
problem.no-space: {{file}} couldn't be saved: the disk is full. Free some space and try again, or save it somewhere else.
problem.blocked: {{file}} couldn't be saved to {{folder}}: the system blocked the write. On Windows, Controlled folder access does this. Allow your browser there, choose another folder, or download it.
problem.unsupported: This browser can't save {{file}} this way. Download it instead.
problem.unknown: {{file}} couldn't be saved. Try again, or download it.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.noLocation: This photo has no GPS coordinates.

viewer.label: {{name}}. Drag or use the arrow keys to move around; Z switches between fit and 100%.
viewer.fitHint: Click the photo to see it at 100%
viewer.cpuPreview: On the processor, the preview covers the area by the divider

result.actualPixels: 100%: one photo pixel per screen pixel

about.title: About Hush
about.name: Hush (靜)
about.what: Removes noise from photos in your browser, on your own graphics chip or processor. Your photos never leave this device.
about.licenceText: Hush is open source under the Apache License 2.0.
about.diagnosticsText: Copy diagnostics: browser, graphics chip, timings and error codes — never file names, metadata or pixels. Paste it into a GitHub issue.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.original: Show the original, or the comparison

unsupported.title: This browser can't run Hush
unsupported.insecure: Hush needs a secure (https) connection to check its noise model and to run at full speed. Open it from an https address, or from localhost.
unsupported.oldBrowser: Hush needs a current browser with WebAssembly and workers. Open it in the latest Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox.

error.unsupported: {{name}} isn't a format Hush can open yet. Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or AVIF photo.
error.cmyk: {{name}} is a CMYK JPEG, made for printing presses. Hush works on RGB photos: export it as an RGB JPEG and try again.
error.hdr: {{name}} is an HDR photo. Hush saves standard 8-bit photos this version: export an SDR copy and try again.
error.animated: {{name}} is animated. Hush removes noise from still photos: open a single frame instead.
error.decode: {{name}} couldn't be opened. The file may be damaged. Export it again from your photo app and try once more.
error.tooLarge: {{name}} is {{mp}} megapixels, more than this computer can process safely ({{limit}} MP). Resize it and try again.
error.model: The noise model didn't download. Check your connection, then try again.
error.gpu: The graphics chip stopped responding. Try again. If it keeps happening, choose Processor under Advanced, or use another browser.
error.memory: This photo needs more graphics memory than this computer has free. Close other tabs and apps, then try again.
error.output: Noise removal produced an unusable result, so nothing was saved. Try again, or open Hush in another browser.
error.encode: {{name}} couldn't be saved: it needs more memory than this browser gives the encoder. Close other tabs and try again, or save it as PNG.
